constraints: STEP ZERO -- HOMING, WRITTEN FIRST, BEFORE ANY SPECIFICATION WORK. Read DEC-20260805-bb162b's exact text of revisit condition R-D. Read GOAL-ICEX-001's CURRENT next_action. Write homing_decision.md stating: (a) R-D's exact requirement, (b) whether a genuinely zero-compute redesign (no runs, no measured-mean arms, pure derivation and arithmetic on already-committed numbers) satisfies it, and (c) your resulting decision: proceed under GOAL-ECDLP-001 because R-D is satisfied, OR stop here and recommend routing to GOAL-ICEX-001 because it is not. IF YOU STOP, do not write experiments/EXP-ICEX-2f9337/ at all -- return with homing_decision.md alone and say the routing question is unresolved by design.

IF YOU PROCEED: the contract MUST be genuinely zero-compute. This is not optional polish -- it is the mechanism by which R-D gets satisfied. Remove CTRL-NULL's measured-mean arm or replace it with a closed-form check. Zero declared runs. Every number must trace to arithmetic on values already committed in the ledger or corpus, cited by path.
THIS IS A NEW RECORD, NOT AN EDIT. EXP-ICEX-146ff5 is immutable. specification.yaml must name supersedes: EXP-ICEX-146ff5.

FIX F-1 -- THE UNREACHABLE GATE. GATE-A arm A3's second clause used B*^2 where the identity requires B*^omega; these coincide only at omega=2, off the arm's own grid elsewhere. Correct the identity. Verify by hand-evaluating at m=5,omega=1.90 that your corrected clause returns the target (m+omega-1)/(m-1)=1.4750, and show that computation in repair_report.md.

FIX THE TOLERANCE PROBLEM the reviewer flagged: 'exact rational equality' at tolerance zero is unattainable at non-integer omega through Decimal. Either restrict the omega grid to values where exact equality is achievable and say so explicitly, or replace the zero-tolerance requirement with a stated, justified epsilon and show it cannot be satisfied by any of the three known counting-convention bugs.

FIX F-2 -- THE WINDOW. The admissibility clause d<=omega/(m-1) was derived at the harvest-all optimum and misapplied globally, including to the one-relation-per-target branch where it is vacuous (at the kink B_k=(m!N)^{1/m}, mu=1, T_r=B_k>>1). Re-derive the window applying the clause ONLY in the region where it holds. Show your derivation's result at m=2..12 in repair_report.md and say explicitly whether it is monotone, bounded, or neither -- do not assume the shape from the rejected contract.

GIVE GATE-A GENUINE EXTERNAL CALIBRATION. The rejected version performed zero external calibration, which was the entire point of selecting this proposal. State precisely which already-known result (the Gaudry-Diem exponent, or another you name) the gate reproduces, with the numeric target and tolerance, and verify by hand in repair_report.md that your gate's arithmetic actually reaches that target.
COUPLE D_trial TO B. The rejected contract left D_trial uncoupled from the optimizer's own B, which the reviewer showed moves the window's emptiness boundary. State the coupling explicitly.

CHARGE THE OMITTED COST TERMS the reviewer itemized: this contract must charge preprocessing, relation collection, linear algebra, target descent, verification, memory and multi-target accounting against Pollard rho and BSGS, per GOAL-ECDLP-001's own objective. List each term and its charge explicitly in the specification; do not charge any term at zero without saying so and why.

Correct the two proposals the review refuted at source. IDEA-20260806-3b91c7's novelty framing was refuted by knowledge/literature/KN-LIT-013.md (already holds the S*T^2~N achievability row) -- if you cite it, cite only the surviving comparator question, not the withdrawn novelty claim. Verify dependency availability yourself by attempting the actual imports in this environment before freezing. Do not trust a prior task card's assertion about what is installed.
This task SPECIFIES and, only if homing resolves in favour of GOAL-ECDLP-001, APPROVES. It runs nothing, changes no goal status, promotes nothing. Do not commit.
